block.email_client.apply_hint: Changes remain local until Apply. Restart a loaded Run to use new settings.
block.email_client.invalid_number: Check the numeric value and its limits.
block.email_client.model.title: Email Client
block.email_client.model.description: Read mail over IMAP, prepare immutable drafts and send only after exact approval over SMTP.
block.email_client.help_sender: Bare email address used in the approved From header.
block.email_client.help_allowed_recipien: JSON array of exact email addresses, e.g. ["recipient@example.org"]. No wildcard.
block.email_client.help_send_enabled: Off by default. Every send still requires an exact draft/revision approval on decision.
block.email_client.help_imap_host: DNS name or IPv4 address, without a URL scheme or port.
block.email_client.help_imap_tls: TLS is mandatory and the certificate is verified.
block.email_client.help_imap_secret_ref: secret://workspace/mail_account. The secret is JSON with username and password; never paste credentials here.
block.email_client.help_mailbox: ASCII mailbox name. Read-only access; messages are not marked as read.
block.email_client.help_smtp_host: DNS name or IPv4 address. Required before preparing a draft.
block.email_client.help_smtp_tls: Verified TLS only. All recipients must be accepted before sending content.
block.email_client.help_smtp_secret_ref: JSON wallet secret with username and password. It may be the same reference as IMAP.
block.email_client.help_attachment_root: Only regular files inside this directory can be attached. Snapshots are copied into the block’s private storage.
block.email_client.help_extract_attachme: Save bounded copies under generated filenames in private block storage; never execute them.
block.email_client.help_ca_file: PEM certificate authority file. Empty uses system trust; this never disables certificate verification.
block.email_client.help_timeout_sec: Hard deadline per exchange. Stop terminates the block-owned network process.
block.email_client.help_max_message_byte: Applies to one complete received or prepared message. Default 5 MiB.
block.email_client.help_max_body_chars: Drafts exceeding this length are refused; received text is truncated with an explicit flag.
block.email_client.help_max_messages: Maximum number of message summaries returned by one command.
block.email_client.help_max_scan_uids: Default search covers the newest UID window. Use explicit cursors to scan older mail.
block.email_client.help_max_attachments: Limit both received extraction and outgoing drafts.
block.email_client.help_draft_lifetime_s: Expired drafts cannot be sent. Prepare a new request instead.
block.email_client.help_min_send_interva: Commands received too early are refused, not queued or automatically retried.
block.email_client.help_max_records: Preserve deduplication history. At the limit, new requests are refused; nothing is purged.
block.email_client.help_max_storage_byte: Includes drafts, received attachments and the journal. Default 128 MiB; no automatic cleanup.
